name: topstep_dry_run
summary: Thin MCP wrapper around the existing /data/Projects/trade-blob/ TopstepX scalper. Subprocess calls trade-blob's own venv via tsx_cli.py — does NOT pollute MySpace++ deps. DRY-RUN is the default and only mode unless TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1 env is set AND --confirm flag passed AND dry_run=False. Every order action crystal-anchors tier='trade_action' so 'cc inference-chain --tier trade_action' is the audit-grade trade log.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.notes: account_status | positions | order_market | order_limit | bracket_attach | pnl_intraday | quote_subscribe | cancel_order | flatten_all | health_check

inputs.name: confirm_live
inputs.notes: Must be true AND env TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1 AND dry_run=False for any order_* tool to actually transmit

passes.notes: 3-gate AND: dry_run==False AND env TOPSTEP_LIVE_TRADING=1 AND confirm_live==True. Order_* tools default to DRY-RUN; reads/positions/pnl ignore the gate.

subprocess.run([/data/Projects/trade-blob/.venv/bin/python, scripts/tsx_cli.py, tool, --json, json_args]). Explicit --python avoids inheriting MySpace++ venv. timeout=30s. env carries TOPSTEP_USERNAME + TOPSTEP_API_KEY.
Conditional on tool=='quote_subscribe'. Writes streaming quotes to ~/.cc/topstep_quotes/<symbol>.jsonl. stream_encoder picks it up; trades become embeddable.

tier='trade_action', model='topstepx', scope=tool. metadata.dry_run preserves the gate state for audit. coords=[size, side_signed, intent_price, executed_price] for orders; [equity, day_pnl, margin_used] for status.
Optional. Stdlib http.server on port 8525 exposing the MCP tools as plain HTTP routes. Replit-deployed dashboards query this. Localhost-only by default; toggle via TOPSTEP_BRIDGE_PUBLIC=1.

depends_on: /data/Projects/trade-blob/scripts/tsx_cli.py (Phase D.5 — new tiny CLI shim added to trade-blob)
